req.title: DELETE is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on second and subsequent DELETE calls for the same playerId.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states DELETE /players/{squadNumber} is idempotent: first call returns 2xx (204), second call returns 404. The endpoint uses squad_number as the path key. Tests cover: (1) positive - first DELETE returns 204, (2) state transition - second DELETE returns 404, (3) boundary - third DELETE also returns 404 (idempotency holds beyond second call), (4) negative - DELETE on non-existent player returns 404 immediately, (5) decision table - verifying exact status codes at each state transition step. All tests use pre-loaded squad numbers from the fixture data and drive the app in-process via TestClient.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_delete_idempotency_exact_status_codes_decision_table():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/13')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    assert r1.status_code != 200
    assert r1.status_code != 404
    r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/13')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert r2.status_code != 204
    assert r2.status_code != 200

test_delete_idempotency_exact_status_codes_decision_table()
